heroAboutUs.heading: Our Mission: Empower everyone to be a safety champion
heroAboutUs.description1: In 2014, our three founders lost a mutual friend in a workplace accident. The incident sparked an interest in streamlining workplace safety.
heroAboutUs.description2: Today, thousands of companies worldwide trust Safesite, a powerful, easy-to-use safety management solution proven to cut incident rates in half.
heroAboutUs.quote: With Safesite, we were able to achieve an 84% reduction in recordable incident rate and a 100% reduction in lost time incident rate.
heroAboutUs.name: Derek Smith
